_comment: Model manifest for LTX-2.5 V2V / IC-LoRA / audio support. Consumed by scripts/models/download_models.py. Each entry downloads a single file from a Hugging Face repo into models/<dest>/<filename>. LTX-2.5 is auto-gated on HuggingFace — visit https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 and click 'Agree and Access' once, then set HF_TOKEN. LTX-2.5 uses Gemma 4 (not Gemma 3) and has native audio generation, temporal upscaler, and duration head patch. NOTE: LTX-2.3 IC-LoRAs and the 2.3 spatial upscaler ARE compatible with 2.5 (confirmed by official Lightricks workflows). Cross-referenced with official workflows at https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/tree/master/example_workflows/2.5 and Kijai's repos.

LTX-2.5 22B dev transformer (BF16) — full precision, ~44GB, needs 48GB+ VRAM
LTX-2.5 22B dev transformer (int8-convrot) — quantized, ~22GB, recommended for 24GB GPUs (RTX 4090)
LTX-2.5 22B distilled transformer (BF16) — fewer steps, full precision
LTX-2.5 22B distilled transformer (int8-convrot) — fewer steps, quantized
LTX-2.5 22B distilled transformer (NVFP4) — Blackwell-only (sm_120+), smallest official quant
LTX-2.5 distilled GGUF Q3_K_S — community quant, 12.6GB, smallest available, for 8GB VRAM with --lowvram streaming
LTX-2.5 distilled GGUF Q3_K_M — community quant, 12.9GB, slightly better quality than Q3_K_S, for 8-12GB VRAM with --lowvram
LTX-2.5 distilled GGUF Q4_K_M — community quant, 15.7GB, good quality/size balance, for 12-24GB VRAM
LTX-2.5 distilled GGUF Q5_K_M — community quant, 18.1GB, higher quality, for 24GB VRAM
LTX-2.5 distilled GGUF Q8_0 — community quant, 23.6GB, highest quality GGUF, for 48GB+ VRAM
LTX-2.5 video VAE (BF16) — decodes video latents to frames
LTX-2.5 video VAE conv variant (BF16) — alternative VAE with conv architecture
LTX-2.5 audio VAE (BF16) — decodes audio latents to waveform, required for native audio generation
Distilled speed-up LoRA (450-step training, enables 8-step sampling instead of ~30)
2x latent spatial upscaler for LTX-2.5 — doubles resolution (e.g. 720p → 1440p)
2x latent temporal upscaler for LTX-2.5 — doubles frame count (e.g. 24fps → 48fps interpolation)
Duration head patch for LTX-2.5 — enables variable duration control beyond default context length
IC-LoRA: pixel-spatial upscaler — reference-image-guided spatial upscaling with detail enhancement
Gemma 4 E2B IT text enhancer — second text encoder used by official LTX-2.5 workflows for prompt enhancement (rewrites short prompts into full cinematic descriptions). From Comfy-Org/gemma-4.
LTX-2.3 spatial upscaler x2 — confirmed compatible with LTX-2.5 by official Lightricks two-stage workflow. Use this if the 2.5 upscaler is unavailable.
